Manual run of ci.yml on staging / main: test and deploy everything.

div.div:
Run by hand on an android-* environment. Every build resolves the speech model URL from R2 and bakes it in as EXPO_PUBLIC_STT_MODEL_URL.
Only android-production with publish=true holds the R2 token: it uploads missing model files under stt-model/<version>/ and the signed APK.
A staging build with a new model version only warns: voice input cannot download its model.
CI job stt-model runs the same fetch on the pull request, without R2.
